behaviour.$description: dv-render TYPE PARTIAL — scatter. Built #260 (s259-D1, the fast follower to the #259 engine). Registers dvRender.types.scatter and draws MARKS only from ctx; the core (dv-render) owns the value scale, the y furniture, the table spine and the resize dispatch. TWO things this partial owns that no sibling does: (1) a NUMERIC X AXIS — every other type reads spec.categories as a band, but a scatter's x is a measurement, so this partial parses a number out of each category and scales x by it (falling back to band centres when any category is not a number), and emits the second axis's gridlines and tick labels itself off dvRender.util.nice; the missing spec field is filed as a core request in knowledge/_tmp/260/scatter.core-requests.md. (2) SHAPE as the non-colour channel (§04.3) — circle/square/diamond/triangle by series index, each `.dv-mk` so the fit moves the glyph instead of stretching it, each wrapped in `g.dv-marker[data-fx][data-x0]` because fitOne branches on TAG and has no circle branch (the #72 discharge shape), each with an invisible r=12 `circle.dv-hit` carrying the interactive attributes (AA 2.5.8 / s116-D1: a 24px target around a 9px mark). requires `data-dv-type="` — the figure must say which chart it is; the engine reads the type off the spec and the gate reads it off the figure, and a disagreement between them is the defect this catches.
